references.text: Ehud uses the double-edged sword he had made to kill King Eglon, as described here.
Reference to a double-edged sword as a weapon in God's service.
Description of a double-edged sword as a metaphor for sharpness and danger.
God's word is compared to a double-edged sword that penetrates deeply.
A sharp, double-edged sword comes from Christ's mouth in John's vision.
Christ is described as the one who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
David also uses a sword hidden at his side to kill the enemy Goliath.
